item.text: {"decisions":[{"id":"metadata-chain-attribution","verdict":"pass","reason":"Correctly localizes the failure to workspace-files Remote/provider metadata delivery, using the successful file-trace contrast and meta.status none; it separates this from disk, tab creation, and scope policy."},{"id":"valid-probes-and-partitioning","verdict":"partial","reason":"Correctly rejects the oversized joined 404 and recognizes the 62/62 evidence and boot roster, but incorrectly characterizes the loader as using individual requests rather than bounded combo partitioning."},{"id":"distractors-and-tab-scope","verdict":"pass","reason":"Separates paste-input warnings from the resource failure and correctly explains the textpreview-to-documentpreview replacement and session-only canOpen scope."},{"id":"ordered-mitigation","verdict":"partial","reason":"Provides the required restart, rollback to 0.1.3-alpha.2, and upstream order and rejects plugin workarounds, but does not explicitly reject duplicate workspace-files service insertion."},{"id":"upstream-forensics-and-fail-loud","verdict":"pass","reason":"Includes the required version, profile, address, roster, probe, contrast, status, and invalid-probe caveats, and proposes boot checks covering registration, provider readiness, and metadata reads."}],"caps":[{"id":"invalid-probe-as-missing-bytes","triggered":false,"reason":"The report explicitly rejects treating the oversized aggregate 404 as evidence of missing modules."},{"id":"plugin-workaround-or-duplicate-insert","triggered":false,"reason":"The report rejects plugin rewrites, retries, and fallbacks and recommends fixing the host chain; it does not affirmatively recommend duplicate insertion."}]}
